The ticket classifier is in `./app`, and `mvn -B -ntp -DskipTests test-compile` passes. I did not run the tests, start the app or call a model, so `POST /classify` itself is untested.

`POST /classify` takes `{"ticket": "..."}` and returns `{"category": "BILLING" | "TECHNICAL" | "OTHER"}`. It rejects blank tickets and tickets over 4,000 characters with a 400 before any model call.

- **Model:** Ollama with `qwen3:1.7b` at temperature 0. You need `ollama serve` running and that model pulled before the endpoint works. I used the smaller model because classification is a cheap, deterministic task; say if you want a bigger one.
- **Fallback:** The model call has a 60-second timeout. If it times out or fails, the endpoint returns `OTHER` rather than an error, so an Ollama outage shows up as `OTHER` in results.
- **Prompt-injection guard:** The ticket text goes into the prompt inside `<ticket>…</ticket>` delimiters. A guardrail rejects tickets that contain those tags or the phrase "ignore previous instructions".
- **Test:** One smoke test, `TicketClassifierTest`, checks that the classifier service is wired. It needs no running Ollama.

I added `smallrye-fault-tolerance` and `http-problem` for the timeout/fallback and error responses, and left out WebSockets since nothing here streams. Dev Services are disabled and dev-mode prompt logging is on. `quarkus_create` auto-started dev mode, so I stopped it right after.

The main files are `TicketClassifier.java`, `ClassifyResource.java` and `application.properties`, all under `app/src`.
